messages:
Maria (Finance): Hey team, Bluewave reported two invoices for March. One invoice is missing the reserved capacity line items; the other looks like a partial re-issue with a different total. Can we triage?
billing-bot: Automated alert: invoice_generation_failures=2 for customer_id=bluewave_corp, job=monthly_batch_v2, run=2026-03-22T04:12Z :warning:
Alex (Eng): Looking at the batch logs now. Unclear if it's a retry or a race in the proration/commit join.
Maria (Finance): Customer sees charge mismatch vs dashboard. They're asking for corrected PDF + credit if we overcharged. Sarah, customer is waiting on an updated invoice before renewal discussion.
Sarah (AM): Ack. They're on a reserved contract, 3-node pool. This impacts renewals if not sorted today.
Raj (Support): Ticket #5421 from Bluewave attached: https://support.redwood.ai/t/5421 — they included both PDFs. One invoice has line items 0 for reserved_capacity.
Tim (Billing Eng): Can you paste the invoice IDs? I want to trace generation run and templates.
Maria (Finance): Invoice IDs in the PDFs: 2026-03-09002 and 2026-03-09002-REV1 (but REV1 has higher total).
Alex (Eng): Running quick query: 
```sql
select invoice_id, status, generated_by, total_cents, line_items_count
from invoices
where customer_id='bluewave_corp' and created_at >= '2026-03-01'
order by created_at desc;
```
Alex (Eng): Results show two rows: 2026-03-09002 total_cents=0 line_items_count=3; 2026-03-09002-1 total_cents=135000 line_items_count=9. Both point to batch run id=batch_2026_03_09_0412.
Tim (Billing Eng): Hmm. Looks like an incomplete line-item insert followed by a retry that appended full items but didn't mark the first as void. Sounds like our dedupe on retry failed.
Raj (Support): Bluewave is asking if we'll void the zeroed invoice and re-send. They want the PDF with corrected line items and a note about the credit.
Maria (Finance): Please prioritize: we need corrected invoice + credit note. Also need root cause and a rollback path.
Tim (Billing Eng): On it. Initial plan: 1) Void invoice 2026-03-09002 (status->void) 2) Mark 2026-03-09002-1 as canonical and regenerate PDF with audit note. 3) Backfill ledger entries if any zero-amount entries were posted.
Alex (Eng): I can add a guard to make retry write operations idempotent by using batch_run_id as upsert key for line_items table. Will open PR.
Sarah (AM): Can we confirm no customer-facing charge has been billed yet? If payment was captured we need immediate refund.
Maria (Finance): Payment status: authorizations present on both, but capture only on REV1 (2026-03-09002-1). So we need a credit note for the earlier 0 invoice? It didn't capture but confused their accounting.
Raj (Support): Customer asked for ETA. Can we answer with 4 hours? They're on PST.
Tim (Billing Eng): I can do the void + PDF regen in ~2 hours if no infra approvals. Alex's PR for idempotency will be separate and may take a day.
Maria (Finance): Ok proceed with void + regen. Please include audit trail text: "Invoice voided due to duplicate generation; see internal ref batch_2026_03_09_0412."
Alex (Eng): PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/billing/+/pr/318 — adds upsert on (batch_run_id, invoice_id, line_item_key).
Tim (Billing Eng): Patch deployed to staging, running the void script now: `python scripts/void_invoice.py --id 2026-03-09002 --reason "duplicate generation"`
billing-bot: Job update: void_invoice job completed for invoice=2026-03-09002, user=tim (status=success)
Tim (Billing Eng): Regenerated PDF and pushed to support ticket. Added audit note.
Raj (Support): Sent updated PDF and explanation to Bluewave. They responded: "Thanks — can you confirm the credit note will appear on next statement?"
Maria (Finance): We'll issue a credit memo; finance will record it against their next invoice. I'll prepare the memo and email ops to approve.
Sarah (AM): Thanks team. Please add a short postmortem once Alex's PR is merged so we can share with the customer.
Alex (Eng): Will follow up tomorrow with postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.
Maria (Finance): Closing loop — Tim, please drop a short note here when the ledger backfill is done.
Tim (Billing Eng): Backfill completed. ledger entries reconciled. Note added: "backfilled missing reserved_capacity lines for invoice 2026-03-09002-1"
Maria (Finance): Great. I'll send the credit memo now and update the ticket. Thanks everyone. :heart:
